user.title: AT&T Gateway
user.description: Enter the device access code printed on the label on the gateway. Home Assistant logs in with it before anything is saved.

data_description.access_code: The device access code on the gateway's label, used to log in to its web interface. It is not the Wi-Fi password.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Change these only if the gateway is not at AT&T's default address or you installed your own certificate on it.

data_description.host: The gateway's LAN address. AT&T gateways use 192.168.1.254 unless it was changed.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off unless you have installed your own trusted certificate on the gateway; it ships a self-signed one.

unreachable.title: Home Assistant cannot reach the gateway
unreachable.description:
The gateway did not answer at {host}. Check these, then press Submit to try again with the same access code:

- The gateway is on and its web page opens at {url} from a device on the same network as Home Assistant.
- On a network split into segments or VLANs, Home Assistant can route to the gateway's LAN address.
- The address below is the gateway's. AT&T gateways use {default_host} unless it was changed.
- Verify the gateway's certificate is off, unless you installed your own certificate on it.

data_description.host: The gateway's LAN address. AT&T gateways use 192.168.1.254 unless it was changed.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off unless you have installed your own trusted certificate on the gateway; it ships a self-signed one.

schedule.title: Automatic reboot schedule
schedule.description: The schedule is off, so the gateway reboots only when you press Reboot or an automation calls the action. Press Submit to finish, or choose a schedule now. You can change it later under Configure. A scheduled reboot is skipped if the gateway has only just come up.

data_description.schedule: How often to reboot automatically. Off leaves rebooting entirely to the button, the action, or your own automations.
data_description.schedule_time: Local time at which the reboot runs.
data_description.schedule_weekday: Used only for a weekly schedule.

reconfigure.title: AT&T Gateway
reconfigure.description: Change the address, the access code or the certificate check. The gateway at the address must be the one this entry was set up for; it is recognised by its serial number.

data_description.access_code: Leave blank to keep the stored access code, or enter the new one printed on the label on the gateway.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off unless you have installed your own trusted certificate on the gateway.

reauth_confirm.title: AT&T Gateway
reauth_confirm.description: The access code for the gateway at {host} was rejected. Enter it again.

data_description.access_code: The device access code printed on the label on the gateway.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the gateway at that address.
error.unknown: Unexpected error talking to the gateway.
error.still_cannot_connect: The gateway still did not answer. Check the points above, then press Submit again.

abort.already_in_progress: A setup of this gateway is already in progress.
abort.another_gateway: That address answers as a different gateway than this entry was set up for.

init.title: Automatic reboot schedule
init.description: Optionally reboot the gateway on a schedule. The button and the reboot action stay available regardless. A scheduled reboot is skipped if the gateway has only just come up.

data_description.schedule: How often to reboot automatically. Off leaves rebooting entirely to the button, the action, or your own automations.
data_description.schedule_time: Local time at which the reboot runs.
data_description.schedule_weekday: Used only for a weekly schedule.

not_loaded.message: The AT&T Router Reboot integration is not loaded, so this action cannot run.

auth_failed.message: The gateway rejected the access code: {error}

reboot_failed.message: The reboot could not be sent to the gateway: {error}

cannot_connect.message: The gateway could not be reached: {error}

update_failed.message: The gateway answered with a page that could not be read: {error}

scheduled_reboot_failed.title: The scheduled gateway reboot failed
scheduled_reboot_failed.description:
The automatic reboot of the AT&T gateway did not go through: {error}

A scheduled reboot has nobody watching it, so this notice is the only place it shows. Check that the gateway still answers at its address and that the device access code is the one printed on its label, then press the Reboot button to try again. This issue clears itself when a reboot succeeds, or when the schedule is set to Off under Configure.

reboot.name: Reboot gateway
reboot.description: Reboots the AT&T gateway now. Takes no fields: the integration manages one gateway.
